notes: simons.ca was unreachable over direct HTTP from this host (both Cloudflare A records time out on connect) and category pages also serve a Cloudflare 'Security Verification' interstitial; all pages were retrieved through the r.jina.ai rendering proxy with retries. Home department = 'Maison'; English locale (/en) used. Every qty comes from the listing header element N, cross-checked against the pager's data-products attribute on the same page (both agree on every row). Sub-category names are the site's own left-nav labels. /en/outdoor/outdoor-decor--1004 (153) and /en/outdoor/outdoor-lighting--1616 (61) are duplicates of the Decor-tree pages and were dropped. Excluded per brief: bathroom, bedding, rugs, furniture, curtains/cushions/throws/placemats/napkins (textiles), baskets & storage, kitchenware/appliances, cutlery, stationery, wallpaper, tech & audio, food & drink, kids.
